**Considering SVG poster creation**

The user seems to want an SVG poster, but I know there's a previous refusal because of credit issues. I can't measure the original but could offer a new, prominent size instead. It might be better to use a tool plan to avoid unnecessary refusals. I could provide an SVG directly in a code block rather than through a link, but I want to clarify the original is not usable because of insufficient credits.

**Creating SVG with Georgia font**

I need to provide a concise introduction explaining that there is no original baseline to refer to, especially regarding the font size and center point. Since the original font isn't available, I’ll choose Georgia. The user wants a screenshot of the SVG code, and since there's no original rendered font, I can communicate that by saying, "Since no original was rendered, there’s no exact font size or center point to preserve. Here’s a credit-free SVG version with a prominent layout." I can generate the lengthy code without needing a tool.

Since no original was rendered, there isn’t an exact font size or centre point to preserve. Here’s a **640 × 640 SVG poster**, using a 60px headline—150% of a 40px baseline—with a centred position and a simple coffee-cup illustration.

Save this as **`slow-sunday.svg`** and open it in a browser. No Magic Hour credits are needed.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="640" height="640" viewBox="0 0 640 640">
  <rect width="640" height="640" fill="#F7F0E3"/>

  <text x="320" y="145"
        text-anchor="middle"
        dominant-baseline="middle"
        font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif"
        font-size="60"
        fill="#493024">SLOW SUNDAY</text>

  <g stroke="#493024" stroke-width="4"
     stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Gentle wisps of steam -->
    <path d="M300 405 C289 391 311 381 300 366
             M328 405 C317 391 339 381 328 366"
          fill="none" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- Cup handle -->
    <path d="M363 434 C407 424 411 479 362 477"
          fill="none"/>

    <!-- Cup -->
    <path d="M270 429 H368 L360 480
             Q357 501 320 501
             Q283 501 279 480 Z"
          fill="#E7D4B8"/>

    <!-- Coffee surface -->
    <ellipse cx="319" cy="430" rx="49" ry="9"
             fill="#79503A"/>

    <!-- Saucer -->
    <path d="M254 511 Q320 531 386 511"
          fill="none"/>
    <path d="M265 510 H375"
          fill="none" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```
